# ActionMesh
> Define an action once. Call it from agents, HTTP, MCP-style tools, or CLI.

ActionMesh is a framework-agnostic TypeScript action registry with shared input/output validation,
stable errors, retries, and lightweight MCP-style, HTTP, and CLI adapters.

Repository: https://github.com/yashkhou/actionmesh
Docs: https://yashkhou.github.io/actionmesh/
License: MIT
Canonical technical source: the GitHub README and source code.
